context: A student interviews the doctor about a disease
purpose: Interview on illness; teach 感染/拒否/対処/防衛/認定/形態/青年/実質

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、この病気はどう広がるんですか？
lines.en: Doctor, how does this disease spread?
lines.style: curious interviewer asking clearly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 接触で感染が広がります。
lines.style: doctor answering precisely, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ワクチンを拒否する人もいますよね。
lines.en: Some people refuse the vaccine, right?
lines.style: interviewer raising a real issue, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、ですが早期の対処が肝心です。
lines.en: Yes, but early action is crucial.
lines.style: doctor stressing a key point, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体の防衛反応って、どう働くんですか？
lines.en: How does the body’s defense response work?
lines.style: interviewer probing the science, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 免疫が敵を認定して、攻撃します。
lines.en: The immune system identifies the enemy and attacks.
lines.style: doctor explaining vividly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ウイルスの形態は変化するんですか？
lines.style: interviewer following up, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: します。特に青年層での流行が懸念されます。
lines.en: It does. Spread among young people is a concern.
lines.style: doctor noting a worry, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実質、予防が最大の対策ですね。
lines.en: Essentially, prevention is the biggest measure.
lines.style: interviewer summarizing the lesson, voice clear and distinctly their own
